2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch adds zero-copy functionality to the fuse io-uring implementation, eliminating memory copies between applications, kernel, and servers for read/write operations. The server can directly access client pages or page cache folios without copying data through an intermediary buffer. Zero-copy is gated behind CAP_SYS_ADMIN and requires bufpools. The request flow involves registering relevant pages in a sparse slot of the server's io_uring registered buffer table, allowing the server to operate on these pages directly using fixed buffer operations. Non-page-backed arguments will still go through the payload buffer as normal.
